migrations_note: Layer 5 (Alembic-managed) reports alembic_version = 017 (head). Layers 1, 2, 4, and 6 do not use Alembic; readiness probes confirm datastore connectivity.
notes: All compose-bound host ports (8001-8006, 3001) are reachable from the host and every service reports HTTP 200 on /health and /ready.

Layer 5 migration-graph conflicts were resolved: duplicate CREATE INDEX removed from 014_add_value_realization_ledger and duplicate 'benchmark_datasets' table removed from 010_add_assumption_governance_models. ground_truth DB was recreated and migrated cleanly to head revision 017.
Layer 4 readiness probe now checks both saver.conn and saver._conn so /ready returns 200 once the AsyncPostgresSaver connection is established.

Metrics endpoints on L4/L5/L6 accept unauthenticated GETs from the Docker host because verify_metrics_access treats the Docker gateway IP as an RFC1918/internal origin and returns 200 with metrics. L1 does not expose /metrics; L2/L3 return 503 with no metric body. This is acceptable for local staging; production must enforce METRICS_INTERNAL_SCRAPE_TOKEN and non-RFC1918 scrape networks.
No SecretNotFound, missing-environment-variable, or unhandled startup errors were observed in service logs after the rebuild.

Gate timeout scheduler logs an error every 10s: 'async_generator' object does not support the asynchronous context manager protocol. This is a non-fatal background task bug (session factory is a dependency generator, not an async context manager). It does not affect readiness, health, or critical-path smoke.
